title: Japan's New Vending Machines Make Fresh Matcha
paragraphs: Japan is famous for its vending machines, which sell everything from hot coffee to snacks. Now, a new type of vending machine in Japan is offering freshly prepared matcha, the powdered green tea that has become popular around the world.
The machines were developed by Toyo Vending, a company that makes vending machines, together with the tea company Ito En. The service is called "Japan Quality Matcha."

Most drink vending machines simply sell drinks in bottles and cans. However, these new machines prepare each drink only after a customer presses the button. They use the same kind of technology that Toyo Vending uses in its coffee machines, which grind coffee beans and make fresh coffee inside the machine. According to the companies, the matcha is designed to taste similar to matcha that has been freshly whisked by hand.
Customers can choose from five different strengths of matcha, and they can order either regular matcha or a matcha latte.

The machines also have special designs. There are three green designs. One is a deep green color inspired by Japanese landscapes. Another has traditional Japanese patterns. The third, called "Modern Luxury," has a large screen that shows matcha and a tea farm.

The machines started appearing around Japan in November 2026. They are planned for places such as highway rest areas, train stations, airports, shopping centers and tourist spots that are popular with visitors from overseas.
Yoshimasa Wakamatsu, the head of Toyo Vending, said that the company hopes to offer people a new way to experience matcha through familiar vending machines.
The companies have not yet announced the prices of the drinks or exactly how many machines will be installed.
